sections.heading: Someone is injured or in immediate danger
sections.text: The support desk cannot arrange emergency help or give medical advice. Anyone in immediate danger should contact local emergency services or the site's emergency contact now. Tier 1 staff record minimal details and route the report to the human safety contact. The Auditor decides the urgency.

steps.text: Tell the reporter that the support desk cannot arrange emergency help, and that anyone in immediate danger should contact local emergency services or the site's emergency contact now.
Record the site and the time of the report. Do not record medical details.

information_needed.prompt: Synthetic site identifier named in the report.

stop_conditions.text: Do not give medical advice or arrange help at Tier 1. Route the report to the human safety contact.
